notes.title: Update 1.8.4 available
notes.notes:
We have updated Dodo Adventures to 1.8.4. The version can be seen when you launch Dodo Adventures with a VR device. The version is located on a menu bar on the lower right hand corner.

[list]
[*]We have fixed some bugs related to render order and graphics. Also, we have started the story development in the Office (the first scene when you start the game).
[/list]

[list]
[*]There is now an ending! When you finish the game and go it though, you will realize that the office has now changed. If you have visited all the places the locks are now gone and there is a new item in the office.
[/list]

[list]
[*]Now, you can also visit all of the locations separately when you start the experience.
[/list]

[list]
[*]Some new realistic food items added to the experience. We are about to replace the coconuts with the actual items that the Dodo ate 400 years ago. These include figs from Madagascar!
[/list]

More coming up!

notes.title: Update v1.6.5: New info canvas when you start the game
notes.notes:
As requested, we added some changes to the game's starting scene. When you start the game there will be a canvas giving some info of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37725050/4334517873697a0bd36fdbe74d4e9a5e4bb9f756.png[/img]

Here is the info: 

Dodo Adventures aims to bring awareness to the human impact on planet earth and bring compassion towards extinct animal species. In the game, you need to collect items and explore surroundings. 

You will start in an office as a human being when things suddenly go wrong and an unknown person calls you. After you try to answer to the call, a portal of another world activates and you will be taken 400 years back to the time when things existed in their natural surroundings.

Explore the island by realizing who you are, collecting items, meeting a Dodo and affecting to the natural day and night cycle. In the end, you need to figure out how to get back to the office. You will figure out whether it will be a dream, a story or a meditation trip to the past.

Enjoy some music, look and listen. Feel your touch. Breath deeply.

Update is about 2 MB.

Cheers,
Juho

notes.title: Dodo Adventures - The Story Behind Our VR experience
notes.notes:
[h1]Dodo Adventures - VR Experience to meditation, exploration and realization[/h1]

[i]We are celebrating Steam Summer Festival 2020 this year with upcoming release of Dodo Adventures. Dodo Adventures is a nature related experience and game where you can teleport yourself to the past, tropical island where you are not quite a human being anymore![/i]

[h3]Your holiday destination this year: Hamari Island. This non-violent VR adventure will give you a much-needed break from the reality. You can choose to explore a tropical island or fill tasks to further the story. [/h3]

[h1]See details about our team! [/h1]

[i]We are from TechLemon Ltd and started Dodo Adventures as an idea while traveling in the Indian Ocean in 2018. We are all together five team members and work mostly remotely (currently!) from many parts of the world. [/i]

Juho: My name is Juho. I am a developer in mixed reality and interactive design projects. I am a founder and developer for DODO Adventure Series and have experience in publishing games. I believe that building a cool community internationally helps the people who are part of the project. Can you make impact to the world by making immersive serious games: "Absolutely! The chances are great!" I have a strong interest in nature conservation and serious games development as the world is changing and finding solution to battle climate change is becoming more and more important. I am also interested in ceramic art as I am wheel-throwing during my free time as well as playing the guitar. I'm is a human-computer interaction (hci) M.Sc. graduate from the Royal Institute of Technology(KTH) in stockholm.

Aune: Aune is hailing from Estonia and has done extensive work with Dodo Adventures marketing and planning. Recently, she stepped up to make story flows for the game itself. Aune will travel from Estonia to Finland and back.

Andres: Search Engine Optimization. Website Optimization. Graphic Content. Marketing Research. Metal Guitarist.

Ella: Visual artist. Low poly 3D modelling 

Elio: Music and sound design

Gurunath - Graphic design

Welcome to out Steam Summer Festival and see and play a demo of our Dodo Adventures.
